properties.name: Summersville Lake Dam Overlook
properties.short: Roadside overlook above Summersville Lake — West Virginia's largest lake, known for some of the clearest, deepest-blue water in the eastern United States.

properties.name: Hawks Nest State Park
properties.short: State park in Ansted with a canyon-rim overlook high above the New River Gorge.

properties.name: Kanawha Falls
properties.short: A wide, roadside waterfall on the Kanawha River at Glen Ferris — no hiking required.

properties.name: Fayette Station Road & Tunney Hunsaker Bridge
properties.short: A steep, switchbacked road descending into the New River Gorge to a river-level bridge beneath the New River Gorge Bridge.

properties.name: Coal Heritage Trail
properties.short: A National Scenic Byway through the historic coal-mining communities of southern West Virginia.

properties.name: Babcock State Park
properties.short: State park home to the Glade Creek Grist Mill, purported to be the most photographed spot in West Virginia.

properties.name: Fat Eddie's
properties.short: Hot dogs, burgers, and blended ice-cream 'storms' a half-mile from Summersville Lake and the Gauley - a warm-weather rider refuel.

properties.name: Almost Heaven Swing - Summersville Lake State Park
properties.short: Overlooks Summersville Lake, the 'Little Bahamas of the East,' at the state's newest park; short uphill walk.

properties.name: Summersville Lake Retreat & Lighthouse
properties.short: Cabins, RV and tent sites, vintage campers, pontoon and watercraft rentals, and lighthouse tours — voted Best Campground in West Virginia five years running.

properties.name: Bear Mountain Cabins & Campground
properties.short: Cabins, RV, and tent sites a mile from the New River Gorge Bridge - Amish-built cabins and a general store with hand-dipped ice cream.

properties.name: Cathedral Cafe
properties.short: Coffee, breakfast, and lunch inside a converted 120-year-old church in downtown Fayetteville - a New River Gorge staple.

properties.name: Rifrafters Campground
properties.short: Quiet family campground two miles from the New River Gorge Bridge, off Rt 19 - RV, tent, and rustic cabin sites.

properties.name: Almost Heaven Swing - Babcock State Park
properties.short: Swing framed on the Glade Creek Grist Mill, one of the most photographed spots in West Virginia; short walk from the main lot.

properties.name: The Tractor Bar
properties.short: Live-music bar off Route 19 at Mount Nebo, a short run from Summersville Lake.
